 Happy Diwali 2026 Wishes: 67+ Best Messages, Quotes, WhatsApp Status, Instagram Captions And Greetings 
 Happy Diwali 2026: Diwali is one of the most beautiful and widely celebrated festivals in India. It is not just a festival but is traditionally celebrated as a festival of welcoming a new season, wealth, health and prosperity. 
 The festival is also known as Deepawali, the Festival of Lights. It also symbolises the victory of good over evil, light over darkness and hope over despair. 
 On this auspicious occasion, people clean their houses and let out negative energy. They also decorate their homes and light diyas and make rangolis to welcome the Goddess of Wealth and Health, Maa Lakshmi. 
 Families come together to perform Lakshmi-Ganesh Puja, prepare delicious sweets and celebrate the festival with great enthusiasm. 
 Diwali is also a wonderful opportunity to share happiness, love and positivity with friends, family members and loved ones. People exchange festive greetings, heartfelt messages, quotes and wishes through WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram to make the celebrations even more special. 
 If you are looking for the best Happy Diwali wishes in 2026, here is a collection of more than 65 beautiful messages. From heartfelt family wishes to funny greetings for friends, short WhatsApp messages and meaningful Instagram captions, you can choose your favourite greeting and share it with everyone. 
 Happy Diwali 2026: Date and Significance 
 Festival Date: Diwali is celebrated on the Amavasya (new moon day) of the Hindu month of Kartik. 
 Religious Significance: It is one of the most important festivals in Hinduism and symbolises the victory of good over evil, light over darkness and hope over despair. 
 Return of Lord Rama: According to Hindu mythology, Diwali commemorates the return of Lord Rama, Goddess Sita and Lakshmana to Ayodhya after 14 years of exile and Lord Rama's victory over Ravana. 
 Lighting of Diyas: The people of Ayodhya welcomed Lord Rama by lighting rows of earthen lamps, a tradition that continues to be an integral part of Diwali celebrations. 
 Worship of Goddess Lakshmi: The festival is associated with Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity. Devotees worship Goddess Lakshmi and Lord Ganesha to seek blessings. 
 Diwali Celebrations: People clean and decorate their homes, light diyas, make rangolis, exchange gifts and prepare traditional sweets. 
 Family Gatherings: Families come together to perform Lakshmi-Ganesh Puja, share festive meals and celebrate the occasion with their loved ones.

 How To Share Diwali Wishes on WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram? 
 Sharing Diwali wishes on social media is a simple way to connect with friends, family members and loved ones. You can send a personal greeting, upload festive photographs or share a beautiful message to make someone's celebration more special. 
 Here is a step-by-step guide to sharing your favourite Diwali wishes: 
 1. How to Share Diwali Wishes on WhatsApp 
 Open WhatsApp and select the contact or family group you want to wish. 
 Choose your favourite Diwali message from the list. 
 Copy and paste the greeting into the chat. 
 You can also attach a festive photograph or greeting card before sending it. 
 To reach more people, open the Status section and upload a Diwali image with your favourite caption. 
 2. How to Share Diwali Wishes on Facebook 
 Open Facebook and go to the Create Post option. 
 Select a festive photograph, greeting card or Diwali quote. 
 Add a personal message or one of your favourite Diwali wishes. 
 Tag your friends and family members, if you wish. 
 Click on Post to share your festive greetings. 
 3. How to Share Diwali Wishes on Instagram 
 Open Instagram and tap the '+' icon to create a new post or Story. 
 Select a festive photograph, video or greeting card from your gallery. 
 Add a beautiful Diwali caption or quote. 
 You can also use festive stickers, music and filters to make your Story more attractive. 
 Tap Share to publish your festive greeting. 
 4. How to Share Diwali Wishes Through Instagram Stories 
 Open Instagram and select Add Story. 
 Choose a picture of diyas, rangoli or your Diwali celebrations. 
 Add a short festive wish or meaningful quote. 
 Personalise your Story with music, stickers or GIFs. 
 Tap Your Story to share it with your followers. 
 Make your Diwali greetings more personal by adding the recipient's name, sharing a memorable photograph or writing a few words of appreciation. A thoughtful message can make even a simple festive greeting feel special. 
 Tip : Add a personal touch to your greetings by including the recipient's name or a special message. A simple and heartfelt wish can make someone's Diwali even more memorable. 
 Diwali brings families together, fills homes with beautiful lights and gives everyone a reason to celebrate. From decorating the house and preparing favourite sweets to exchanging gifts and sharing laughter, every little tradition makes the festival special. It is also the perfect time to reach out to people who matter and let them know how much they are appreciated. A thoughtful message, a cheerful greeting or a lovely festive photograph can add a personal touch to the celebrations. Explore these Happy Diwali 2026 wishes, pick the ones you love and make someone's festive day a little brighter. 🪔 
 Wishing you and your loved ones a very Happy Diwali 2026! 🪔
